title: From Runnable to Shippable: Multi-Agent Test-Driven Development for Generating Full-Stack Web Applications from Requirements
authors: Wan Yuxuan; Liang Tingshuo; Xu Jiakai; Xiao Jingyu; Huo Yintong; Lyu Michael R
note: Abstract fetched. The PDF (arxiv.org/pdf/2605.17242) is what failed for the retrieval agent; the /abs/ page loads normally and was never retried during Phase 3.

quote: we conduct the first controlled study of TDD for full-stack web application generation across 20 diverse web applications, multiple backbone models, two coding agents, and three TDD implementations
With sufficiently capable backbones, TDD improves accuracy by 15.5--23.7 percentage points and remains effective across both minimal and full-featured coding agents
replacing unreliable feedback with a stronger tester restores positive gains for a lower-capability backbone

Incremental TDD provides bounded control, Whole-Project TDD enables coordinated repair and achieves the highest cost efficiency in most configurations, and Agentic TDD performs best with highly capable models
Coding agents can generate runnable web applications, but their outputs frequently fail to satisfy functional requirements.

status: NOT FOUND IN SOURCE — presented as a verbatim quote
detail: Does not appear in the fetched abstract, and its direction partly conflicts with what the abstract does say (Whole-Project TDD 'achieves the highest cost efficiency in most configurations'). The paper's actual capability-dependence statement is E64. Removed wherever it appeared.

finding: Two process failures produced these retractions
detail: (1) The orchestrator did not spot-check any retrieval agent's quotes against their sources before synthesis, despite having flagged subagent quote fidelity as the main risk when dispatching them. (2) A source registered SEARCH-ONLY was permitted to support stated facts in REPORT.md, breaching the run's own methodology rule that such sources 'support no claim stated as fact'. Both were caught by an independent adversarial review, not by the orchestrator. Mitigation for future runs: before synthesis, mechanically cross-check that every citation used in a body document resolves to a source marked FETCHED, and re-fetch any load-bearing number that came from a source an agent could not decode.
